November 28

45 For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many. (Mark 10:45 KJV)

What awesome truths this verse has. Jesus didn’t come for us to minister to Him, but He came to minister to us. Just coming, as a man was such a humbling thing, as He was God in Heaven with all the Glory and power that entails, and to give it all up and come as a man, was quiet a comedown. On top of that, He didn’t come to rule over mankind, and to be the King of Kings that He really is, but came as a servant, to serve and minister to us. WOW! That is amazing, and demonstrates just how much God loves us. This is the same kind of love that God wants us to have for each other (John 13:34). How many of us want to minister to others, and truly put others ahead of ourselves? Not many, as we are mostly consumed with ourselves, and getting all we can for our own selfish desires to be filled. We need to let Jesus live through us, so that we can be like Him, and show that kind of love to others.

Not only did Jesus come to minister to us, but to give His life for us. If we would ponder on this and really understand just what all He did for us, then we should be so full of love and gratitude, that we would do everything in our power to serve Him and glorify Him in everything we do. These truths give us an insight as to how the Kingdom of God works, as it shows how that by sacrificing ourselves for the betterment of others, is how the Kingdom works. We need to do as Jesus said and love our God above all, and our neighbor as ourselves (Matthew 22:37-39), and in that way we will demonstrate that we belong to the Kingdom of God, and that God is love (1 John 4:8). You need to realize that you can not do this in your own strength. You must die to yourself, and let Jesus live through you, before you can live this way, as it goes against all our natural desires. Give yourself completely to Jesus, and let Him live through you, so that you will be like Him, and thereby glorify God in all you say and do. Praise God for Jesus!
